TRIANGULATION ON REASONING-TOKENS BILLING: confirmed via the exact quoted tooltip on platform.openai.com/docs/pricing: "Output prices include visible output tokens and reasoning tokens, even though reasoning tokens are not visible via the API." Applies to the whole Standard/Fast/Batch/Flex table (Astra/Terra/Luna). For chat-latest and gpt-5-search-api (a separate "Other models" table with no such tooltip attached) I could not find that statement restated, so I marked those two lower-confidence on that specific point.

Recommend budgeting for the docs.openai.com version (content = billed) as the conservative/technical source, but do not treat this line item as fully closed.
